errors.text_span: Хоризонталната ос съдържа категориите на желаната подкрепа
errors.evidence: The chart is a horizontal bar chart, so the vertical axis contains the categories, not the horizontal axis.
The bars are clearly sorted in descending order of their values, from top to bottom, not randomly.
This repeats the error that the value for "финансова подкрепа" is 30%; the correct value is approximately 55%.

errors.text_span: Стълбовете варират в височина от 10% до 60%
errors.evidence: The values shown in the chart range from approximately 16% to 55%, not 10% to 60%.
For a horizontal bar chart, the correct term is "дължина" (length), not "височина" (height).
The description does not mention the x-axis scale, which shows values from 0% to 60% with tick marks at 10% intervals.
